title: GET /health hands out the pairing PIN to any LAN client
body:
## Summary
The TV's /health endpoint returns the current pairing PIN, so the PIN protects nothing on the LAN.

## Description
tv-app/src/main/kotlin/dev/telestrator/tv/Health.kt:12 serialises the PIN into the health body; four harness tools (tools/pen-sim.mjs, live-ui-test.mjs, latency-probe.mjs, relay-test.mjs) pair by reading it. Fixed: /health omits the PIN; the harness reads it over adb (logcat or a debug-only intent) instead.

## Flow
- any client on the LAN: GET http://<tv>:8765/health
- read pin from the JSON
- open ws:// with that PIN - pairing accepted

## Expected impact
Closes pairing to anyone who can reach the port; the harness must change in the same commit or it stops pairing.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - pairing PIN is not readable without the screen
Before: PIN present in /health body (Health.kt:12); 4 harness tools depend on it
After: not built: needs a device to measure
Method: simulation - read the code path; a device is needed for the gate rung
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: policy-tighten
evidence: tv-app/src/main/kotlin/dev/telestrator/tv/Health.kt:12; tools/pen-sim.mjs, tools/live-ui-test.mjs, tools/latency-probe.mjs, tools/relay-test.mjs read /health for the PIN

title: After a wrong PIN the companion page reconnects every second, forever
body:
## Summary
A rejected pairing sends the phone into an endless 1-second reconnect loop with the same wrong PIN.

## Description
companion/index.html:147-152 reconnects on every close, including the TV's wrong-PIN refusal. Fixed: a refusal close stops reconnecting and asks for the PIN again.

## Flow
- enter a wrong PIN
- TV refuses and closes
- page reconnects each second with the same PIN, indefinitely

## Expected impact
The phone stops hammering the TV and the learner gets a prompt instead of silence.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a refused pairing asks again instead of looping
Before: reconnect loop, ~60 attempts/min, no prompt
After: not built
Method: simulation - code read; needs a browser + TV to reach gate
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: mainCheckout() and same() duplicated between kpi-measure and worktree-preflight
body:
## Summary
Two tools carry word-for-word copies of the same checkout-discovery helpers.

## Description
tools/kpi-measure.cjs and tools/worktree-preflight.cjs both define mainCheckout() and same(); a fix to one (e.g. a worktree path rule) will not reach the other. Also coveredBy counts a module as tested when a tools file merely names its path. Fixed: one shared helper module required by both; coveredBy requires a require() of the path.

## Flow
- change the worktree rule in one copy
- the other keeps the old rule
- KPI coverage over-reports a module named only in a comment

## Expected impact
One rule, one place; the typecheck/coverage meter stops over-counting.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one implementation of checkout discovery
Before: 2 copies of mainCheckout/same
After: 1 copy (not built)
Method: probe - grep of both files
Result: better
Gate: none

title: The phone follows the TV only at join and Linga start; 8 hand-offs need a tab pick
body:
## Summary
When the TV sends the learner to the phone, the phone does not move to the right panel except in two cases.

## Description
desk/src/app/phone/page.tsx switches panels by itself only on join and when Linga starts; the other 8 TV screens that say 'on your phone' leave the learner choosing among 9 tabs. Fixed: the phone derives its panel from the session screen the way the TV does. Runner-up of card tv-surface B.

## Flow
- TV shows 'photograph your page on the phone'
- phone stays on its last tab
- learner hunts through 9 tabs

## Expected impact
Every hand-off lands on the right panel; one fewer decision per step.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - steps from TV hand-off to the right phone panel
Before: 1 + tab search at 8 of 10 hand-offs
After: 0 (not built)
Method: simulation - walked the 10 hand-offs in code
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: desk/src/app/phone/page.tsx (panel state set only on join and linga start)

title: Phone shows Linga controls the view model does not offer on that screen
body:
## Summary
The phone renders controls that lingaView does not list for the current screen; uat A now offers them as phone-only.

## Description
Found building uat A: the situation list on home and recap, Stop/Not now during a task or topics, and Choose a phrase / Help me answer after a reply are drawn by LingaPhone but not in lingaView(session).actions for that screen. Either view.ts should offer them or the phone should drop them - a product decision.

## Flow
- render LingaPhone on the recap
- compare its controls with lingaView actions
- situation list present, not offered

## Expected impact
One source of truth for what a learner can do on each Linga screen.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - controls outside the view
Before: several phone-only controls across 15 states (listed in results/uat-A.json)
After: 0 once decided
Method: gate - tools/uat-surface-test.cjs parity case
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction

title: The 'k of n right' history line does not update after an item settles
body:
## Summary
Settling an unsure item by explanation changes its verdict but not the set's right-count line.

## Description
Reported by the desk-pipelines B builder: practice.settle records the attempt once and updates the item, but the history line counting right answers is computed at marking and not recomputed. Fixed: the count derives from item verdicts.

## Flow
- mark a set with one unsure item
- explain it - it settles right
- the history still reads k-1 of n

## Expected impact
The learner's record matches the sheet.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - history count equals settled verdicts
Before: count stale after settle
After: count equals verdicts (not built)
Method: simulation - builder's read of the settle path
Result: better
Gate: none

title: recertify's prior[] schema uses minItems, unconfirmed under codex strict mode
body:
## Summary
The first live --recertify run may fail at the judge if codex rejects minItems in a strict schema.

## Description
uat B's judge schema adds prior[] with minItems; codex strict structured output has not been seen to accept that keyword in this repo. Instrument: one codex smoke call with the judge schema (uat/env.md smoke recipe).

## Flow
- node uat/driver/linga-text.cjs --recertify <run>
- judge call with prior[] minItems
- codex rejects the schema -> every pair errors

## Expected impact
Recertify either works first time or fails loudly on call one.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - live recertify accepted by codex
Before: unknown
After: one smoke call decides
Method: simulation - no codex call made in this run (costs, operator's call)
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: uat/driver/linga-text.cjs judge schema (prior[] minItems); results/uat-B.json notes
